description: Tamil Nadu Budget 2026: AI is No Longer the Future – It is the Foundation of Education, said Mr. Ramana Prasad, Founder & Chairman, Meritus AI
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu Government's first Budget under the new administration sends a strong message that the future of education lies in technology, innovation, and Artificial Intelligence. The emphasis on AI-enabled learning, robotics, digital access through free laptops, and industry-aligned skilling demonstrates a forward-looking vision to prepare students for the jobs of tomorrow. AI should not be viewed as a standalone subject but as a foundational skill integrated across school and higher education.
